paths.name: Path of Grungni
paths.description: A mastery path focused on immediate, direct effects

ability.name: Runic Blasting
ability.description: Increases the critical chance of Rune of Fire, Grungni's Gift, and Rune of Striking by 15%.

ability.name: Master Rune of Fury
ability.note:
Requires an active Runic Conduit
You may only have 1 Master Rune active
ability.description: You bind the Master Rune of Fury to your Runic Conduit. Group members within 50 feet of your Runic Conduit gain 50 Action Points and the Action Point cost of their abilities is reduced by 25% for 10 seconds if they remain within 50 feet of the Runic Conduit.

ability.name: Ancestor's Blessing
ability.description: Healing abilities have a 25% chance to also increase your target's AP by 50. This effect will not work on yourself.

ability.name: Rune of Burning
ability.description: You channel a powerful series of runes around your target which project searing flame into them, dealing 1890 Elemental damage over 6 seconds and snaring them by 40% for as long as you maintain your concentration.

ability.name: Rune of Nullification
ability.description: Critical direct damage hits place a debuff on your target that reduces all incoming healing by 35% for 7 seconds.

ability.name: Rune of Binding
ability.description: Wounds your target for 405 Elemental damage and Staggers the target for 6 seconds, preventing all actions unless they're damaged.

ability.name: Rune of Ending
ability.description: Deals 1200 damage to all enemies within 25 feet and then heals all group members within 100 feet for all damage dealt.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Striking
coreAbilities.description: Your rune calls down a bolt of electricity, dealing 489 Elemental damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Grungni's Gift
coreAbilities.description: Grungni blesses your target, restoring 382 health.

coreAbilities.name: Oath Rune of Power
coreAbilities.description:
Increases the target group member's Strength, Ballistic Skill, and Intelligence by 100 for 1 hour. The rune holder may activate to on their next attack deal an additional 1500 Elemental damage over 5 seconds and reduce the victim’s run speed by 20%.
You may only give a player one Oath Rune, but players may bear multiple Oath Runes of different types at the same time.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Fire
coreAbilities.description: Your rune releases a scorching blast, inflicting 330 Elemental damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Restoration
coreAbilities.description:
Your rune infuses the target with vitality, restoring 1126 health.
This is a fragile spell, and will sometimes be set back by a small amount if you are damaged while casting it.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Fortune
coreAbilities.description: Deals 388 Elemental damage to your target and heals your defensive target for 150% of the damage dealt.

paths.name: Path of Valaya
paths.description: A mastery path focused on longer-duration effects

ability.name: Immolating Grasp
ability.description: Each tick of Rune of Immolation has a 25% chance to drain 30 Action Points from the target and snare them by 30% for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Master Rune of Stability
ability.note:
Requires an active Runic Conduit
You may only have 1 Master Rune active
ability.description: You bind the Master Rune of Stability to your Runic Conduit. Group members within 50 feet of your Runic Conduit will instantly be freed from any snaring effects and for the next 10 seconds, group members within 50 feet of your Runic Conduit have their Toughness increased by 250.

ability.name: Earth's Shielding
ability.description: Each attack against an active Rune of Shielding will randomly debuff one of the attacker's stats by 100 for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Rune of Fate
ability.description: Deals 1195 Elemental damage over 15 seconds and heals your defensive target for 150% of the damage dealt.

ability.name: Efficient Runecarving
ability.description: While under the effects of your Rune of Breaking; you gain 10% disrupt strikethrough and each time you deal direct damage, your defensive target is healed for 50% of the damage dealt.

ability.name: Rune of Fulmination
ability.description: You deal 461 Elemental damage to your target and an additional 970 Elemental damage over 5 seconds. If your target is affected by Rune of Immolation, they will have their Elemental Resistance reduced by 360 for 5 seconds.

ability.name: Rune of Rebirth
ability.description: Heals your groupmates within 100 feet 3600 health over 15 seconds and gives 375 Action Points over 15 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Immolation
coreAbilities.description: You set your target ablaze, burning them for 1015 Elemental damage over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Shielding
coreAbilities.description: A shielding rune which absorbs up to 825 damage over 10 seconds. When the effect fades, the target recovers 247 health.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Mending
coreAbilities.description: Restores 309 health, then continues to restore 375 health over 5 seconds. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Oath Rune of Iron
coreAbilities.description:
Increases the targeted group member's Initiative and Willpower by 100 for 1 hour. The rune holder may activate it to cleanse one Curse, one Hex and one Ailment from themselves.
You may only give a player one Oath Rune, but players may bear multiple Oath Runes of different types at the same time.

coreAbilities.name: Spellbinding Rune
coreAbilities.description: A potent rune which suppresses magic, silencing and wounding your target for 535 Elemental damage over 4 seconds.

paths.name: Path of Grimnir
paths.description: A mastery path focused on wide-area effects

ability.name: Concussive Runes
ability.description: Rune of Cleaving grows ever more potent and now also reduces Armor by 660 and Elemental resistance by 240.

ability.name: Master Rune of Adament
ability.note:
Requires an active Runic Conduit
You may only have 1 Master Rune active
ability.description: You bind the Master Rune of Adamant to your Runic Conduit. All allies within 25 feet of your Master Rune gain 512 health. For the next 10 seconds, group members within 50 feet of your Master Rune of Grungni will be periodically cleansed, removing up to one Curse or Ailment every 5 seconds.

ability.name: Extended Battle
ability.description: Increases the duration of Rune of Cleaving and Rune of Battle by 6 seconds.

ability.name: Rune of Battle
ability.note:
Only usable on a non-stealthed player
Target can only be affected by one Rune of Battle
ability.description: Buffs you or a friendly player with a pulsing area of effect that deals 375 Elemental damage every 3 seconds to all enemies within to 25 feet for 15 seconds.

ability.name: Ancestor's Echo
ability.description: Direct heals you cast have a 25% chance to create a shield on your target that can absorb up to 712 damage over 10 seconds.

ability.name: Grimnir's Fury
ability.description: Using the fury of Grimnir you strike all enemies within 25 feet for 238 Elemental damage followed by another 238 Elemental damage after 3 seconds on the same location.

ability.name: Rune of Skewering
ability.description: Deals 2400 damage to all targets 40 feet in front of you.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Might
coreAbilities.description: Your rune transmits a surge of power through the ground, dealing 232 Elemental damage to all targets within 25 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Oath Rune of Warding
coreAbilities.description:
Increases all of the targeted group member's resistances by 240 for 1 hour. The rune holder may activate it to shield themself, absorbing 1162 damage over 10 seconds.
You may only give a player one Oath Rune, but players may bear multiple Oath Runes of different types at the same time.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Serenity
coreAbilities.description: Heals your target for 783 health over 9 seconds, and will then bounce to and heal other allies within 30 feet of the previous target. This effect will not apply itself to the same target more than once, and will heal up to 6 people.

coreAbilities.name: Blessing of Valaya
coreAbilities.description: Heals all group members within 100 feet for 898 health.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Cleaving
coreAbilities.description: A burst of force erupts from your rune, dealing 648 Elemental damage over 9 seconds to targets 40 feet in front of you.

coreAbilities.name: Reinforce War Engine
coreAbilities.description: You heal the ram for 750 health over the next 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Cleanse War Engine
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted cleanse. Removes two siege specific debuffs from a friendly siege engine.

coreAbilities.name: Shield the Skies
coreAbilities.description: Ranged siege engines will deal 90% of the normal damage to you. You will also protect two other group mates within 40 feet. Only one effect of this type may be on a player at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Breaking
coreAbilities.description:
When this ability is toggled on, you gain the Rune of Breaking, converting your Healing Power, Willpower, and Healing Critical Chance bonuses from items into Magic Power, Intelligence, and Magic Critical Chance.

When this ability is toggled off, you gain the Rune of Balance, converting your Magic Power, Intelligence, and Magic Critical Chance bonuses from items into Healing Power, Willpower, and Healing Critical Chance.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Life
coreAbilities.description: Restores life to a slain ally, reviving them with 20% of their health.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Regeneration
coreAbilities.description: You call upon a regenerative rune, restoring 1520 health over 15 seconds to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Preservation
coreAbilities.description: A defensive rune which wards you from your target, reducing all damage that they deal to you by 50% for 15 seconds. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone that you have detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Divine Favor
coreAbilities.description: A strong heal that will restore 1800 health to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Stoutness of Stone
coreAbilities.description: Increases Toughness by 80. You also recover from Stuns, Staggers and Knockdowns 1 seconds quicker. You will still gain immunity based on the original duration.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Cleansing
coreAbilities.note: Target must be Cursed or Ailing
coreAbilities.description: Your rune cleanses an ally, removing one Curse or Ailment.

coreAbilities.name: Rampaging Siphon
coreAbilities.description: Deals 600 damage to all enemies within 25 feet, and heals group members within 100 feet for the full amount of the damage dealt.

coreAbilities.name: Divine Fury
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 25% more damage, but your healing output is reduced by 20%.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Divine Fury
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 25% more damage, but your healing output is reduced by 20%.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Swift Runes
coreAbilities.description: Removes the cooldown of Rune of Cleansing, but increases the cost to 40 Action Points.

coreAbilities.name: Discipline
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Willpower by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Steal Life
coreAbilities.description: Your target suffers 1200 damage over 9 seconds, and you are healed for half of the damage dealt.

coreAbilities.name: Stubbornness
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Corporeal resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Runic Conduit
coreAbilities.description: You inscribe a Runic Conduit into the ground that infuses your group, restoring 152 health health every 3 seconds to those within 50 feet of the Runic Conduit. To maintain your Runic Conduit, you have to remain within 150 feet and your Action Point regeneration is reduced by 5.

coreAbilities.name: Cancel Runic Conduit
coreAbilities.description: Cancel your current Runic Conduit.

coreAbilities.name: Blazing Runes
coreAbilities.description: When casting Rune of Fire you, prepare for your next blazing rune within 10 seconds, increasing the damage of your next Rune of Immolation, Rune of Fire, or Rune of Burning by 25%.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Wrath and Ruin
coreAbilities.description: Your Runic Conduit no longer heals group members, instead it causes the earth to crack, venting forth fire and sulphur, dealing 184 Elemental damage every 3 seconds to all enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Mind
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, you will remove and ignore any rooting, snaring, disarming, silencing or disabling effects. Your cast times are reduced by 50%, and you cannot be set back.

coreAbilities.name: Grimnir's Shield
coreAbilities.description: You will take only 50% damage and your abilities will cost 25% fewer Action Points for 10 seconds. During this time you generate almost no threat, and can not be set back while casting.

coreAbilities.name: Cleansing Vitality
coreAbilities.description: Rune of Cleansing will now heal the defensive target for 537 over 9 seconds if an effect was successfully removed.

coreAbilities.name: Ancestral Inheritance
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Armor by 660.

coreAbilities.name: Divine Protection
coreAbilities.description: Each group member within 100 feet is surrounded by a protective shield for the next 10 seconds that will absorb up to 4500 damage from melee abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Sundering
coreAbilities.description: A rune which ruptures the ground underfoot, knocking back targets within 25 feet of you. Monsters will be knocked down.

coreAbilities.name: Sacrificial Renewal
coreAbilities.description: Whenever you critically heal an ally with a direct healing ability, you increase the power of your heals by 15% for 5 seconds, but you also take 10% more damage from all sources.

coreAbilities.name: Regenerative Shielding
coreAbilities.description: Each tick of Rune of Regeneration has a 25% chance to increase the target's armor by 594 for 10 seconds. Additionally, 10% less armor will be bypassed when they are attacked.

coreAbilities.name: Rune of Insanity
coreAbilities.description: Inflicts 600 damage to the target and they will take an additional 1 second to build up all abilities for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Restorative Burst
coreAbilities.description: Any time one of your direct healing effects critically heals an ally, you will regain 40 Action Points over 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Protection of the Ancestors
coreAbilities.description: Increases target's Wounds by 150 for 30 seconds, healing them for the value of the additional HP gained.

coreAbilities.name: Blessing of Grungni
coreAbilities.description: Critical direct heals will Bless your target for 10 seconds, increasing the power of any heals used on them by 25%.

coreAbilities.name: Mountain Spirit
coreAbilities.description: Increases the armor of all group mates within 100 feet by 1320 and resists by 480 for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Potent Runes
coreAbilities.description: Reduce the cooldown of your Oath Runes granted abilities by 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: On Your Feet!
coreAbilities.description: Rune of Life and Rune of Sanctuary will resurrect players with 50% of their maximum health.

coreAbilities.name: Valaya's Shield
coreAbilities.description: You gain a shield that absorbs 3600 damage over 15 seconds. Each group member within 100 feet will be healed for 1800 health over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Sundered Motion
coreAbilities.description: Rune of Sundering's cooldown is reduced to 20 seconds, and it will now apply a 30% movement reduction for 5 seconds to all those hit.

coreAbilities.name: Thick-Skulled
coreAbilities.description: Rune of Mending, Rune of Restoration and Rune of Serenity can no longer be set back when casting.

coreAbilities.name: Oath Rune of Sanctuary
coreAbilities.description:
Increases the targeted group member's Toughness by 100 for 1 hour. The rune holder will then be able to resurrect themselves with 20% health if killed within the next 10 minutes. Doing so will remove the Oath Rune.
You may only give a player one Oath Rune, but players may bear multiple Oath Runes of different types at the same time.

coreAbilities.name: Alter Fate
coreAbilities.description: Restores 1800 health to all group members within 100 feet and increases your outgoing healing by 35% for 10 seconds.
